articles.text: 学生: 紳士服売場は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Shinshifuku-uriba wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (men's wear) What floor is the men's wear section?
教師: 紳士服売場は二階でございます。 (Kyoushi: Shinshifuku-uriba wa ni-kai de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The men's wear section is on the 2nd floor.
学生: おもちゃ売場は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Omocha-uriba wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (toys) What floor is the toys section?
教師: おもちゃ売場は六階でございます。 (Kyoushi: Omocha-uriba wa rok-kai de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The toys section is on the 6th floor.
学生: 化粧品売場は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Keshoohin-uriba wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (cosmetics) What floor is the cosmetics section?
教師: 化粧品売場は一階でございます。 (Kyoushi: Keshoohin-uriba wa ik-kai de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The cosmetics section is on the 1st floor.
学生: 文房具売場は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Bunboogu-uriba wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (stationery) What floor is the stationery section?
教師: 文房具売場は六階でございます。 (Kyoushi: Bunboogu-uriba wa rok-kai de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The stationery section is on the 6th floor.
学生: 家庭用品売場は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Kateeyoohin-uriba wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (household goods) What floor is the household goods section?
教師: 家庭用品売場は五階でございます。 (Kyoushi: Kateeyoohin-uriba wa go-kai de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The household goods section is on the 5th floor.
学生: 婦人服売場は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Fujinfuku-uriba wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (women's clothing) What floor is the women's clothing section?
教師: 婦人服売場は三階でございます。 (Kyoushi: Fujinfuku-uriba wa san-gai de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The women's clothing section is on the 3rd floor.
学生: 食料品売場は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Shokuryoohin-uriba wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (food) What floor is the food section?
教師: 食料品売場は地下でございます。 (Kyoushi: Shokuryoohin-uriba wa chika de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The food section is in the basement.
学生: 電気器具売場は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Denki kigu-uriba wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (electric appliances) What floor is the electric appliances section?
教師: 電気器具売場は五階でございます。 (Kyoushi: Denki kigu-uriba wa go-kai de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The electric appliances section is on the 5th floor.
学生: 遊園地は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Yuuenchi wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (amusement park) What floor is the amusement park?
教師: 遊園地は屋上でございます。 (Kyoushi: Yuuenchi wa okujoo de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The amusement park is on the roof.
学生: 宝石売場は何階ですか。 (Gakusei: Hooseki-uriba wa nan-gai desu ka?)
STUDENT: (jewelry) What floor is the jewelry section?
教師: 宝石売場は四階でございます。 (Kyoushi: Hooseki-uriba wa yon-kai de gozaimasu.)
INSTRUCTOR (CLERK): The jewelry section is on the 4th floor.
